# Preface {.unnumbered}

This book presents the author’s fifteen chapters on generative AI, from foundations and language models through prompting, system integration, research methods, evaluation, responsible practice, and deployment.

The accompanying project follows the design of an AI-powered research assistant. Readers develop a portfolio of decisions and evaluations for a domain they choose. A working prototype is optional; the project emphasizes explaining and defending a design.

Use the chapter learning goals, terminology, examples, discussion questions, and project milestones to guide study. The original chapters retain their author-supplied wording and organization. Technical examples are presented as written and are not executed by the book build.

The book is available under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0).
